rationale: Wave-1 pass 1 let the planner choose S's task freely. Each row was planned in isolation, so the model returned its modal benign errand every time: houseplant care 20.5% and picnic planning 15.7% of 185 sets, nine domains covering 87%. That makes S separable from T, A, H and P on topic alone, which is the shortcut a probe finds before it finds manner. The planner now receives a deterministic shortlist drawn from this pool and picks one of the offered domains, so the pool - not the model's prior - sets the distribution. The previously dominant domains stay in the pool at one entry each: the aim is proportional representation, not a ban, because banning them would be its own artifact.
selection: Seeded by candidate_id, so the same row is always offered the same domains and a rerun reproduces the draw. A second round offers a disjoint shortlist for rows where none of the first three fit.
